title: Close final PR 129 review gaps for recursive JSON kinds, nonfinite validation, and corrupt StoredState reads
description: Close final PR 129 review gaps for recursive JSON kinds, nonfinite validation, and corrupt StoredState reads
acceptance_criteria: SchemaJSON preserves supported numeric behavior without corrupting declared Int fields; schema validation rejects nonfinite doubles at every recursive depth; schema version 6 advertises null, finite number, array, object, string, integer, and boolean payload values; present but undecodable StoredState values fail as corrupt_state while absent values still use initials; focused regressions and the full 252-test quality lane plus hosted CI pass.
